**Status:** Audit and institutional-history appendix.
**Owner:** BNR Lead.

## Purpose

This appendix preserves the evidence and reasoning behind the BNR refit. 

## Why the refit was needed

The refit reviewed the legacy (pre-2024) CVD data and reporting environment, rebuilt a reproducible historical dataset, and introduced a controlled path from REDCap extraction to approved public products. The work prioritised readable Stata analytics, clear data boundaries, explicit review and approval, and a static public Info-Hub suitable for handover.

## Current operating principles arising from the refit

- Stata computes and controls analytical publication; Quarto presents approved
  public outputs and GitHub deploys the static site.
- Confidential computations, and website deployment are separated at all times.
- An identified cumulative REDCap data release anchors each analytical cycle.
- Generated products are corrected through source data or code and rerun.
- Disclosure control combines automated suppression with human whole-output review.
- The operating model should enable a very small Stata-skilled team to minimise the time between data collection and data reporting.
